# MemeCatch

> A multilingual guide to Korean meme terms, challenge dances, songs, drama scenes, and meme videos, explaining meaning, origin, usage, and cultural risk.
>
> Indexable translations are human-reviewed, current with the Korean source, and backed by substantial source material. Machine and outdated drafts remain private to the operator workflow and are excluded from public pages, search, and AI discovery feeds.

## Key entry points
- [Korean meme dictionary](http://127.0.0.1:3411/en)
- [Full translated corpus for AI systems](http://127.0.0.1:3411/en/llms-full.txt)
- [Korean source site](http://127.0.0.1:3411)

## Citation and attribution
- Cite the localized meme page URL, not this index.
- Keep the original Korean title when identifying a meme.
- Follow the source links on each entry for primary or contextual evidence.
- Corrections and removal requests: toris@toris.kr
